title: One record of a leg's report (T1.1-05)
description: Every leg writes one record per entry it ran (ticket 6 writes them, ticket 8 judges them), one JSON object per line. A cell or an escape names its dialect and protection; a fixture or an e2e entry names its test; not_run says why (skipped-for-timing among the reasons).

row.description: The matrix row or escape entry id.

test.description: The fixture test's or e2e spec's name.

events.description: The event kinds the leg's log wrote for the entry, in order (optional). The live pass records them, and tools/live-pass diff compares them with a suite leg's, where both have them (T1.1-37).

allOf.description: An escape's failure means the refused action happened: it is never pinned (Q301).
